notes: Personally read all50 blinded original source reports and reasoned all600 target states, persisted and validated a complete independent preread before opening the v2 draft or reader flags. Then compared all600 states and all reader notes, read all flags, reread source for disagreements, and authored complete final records. No gold, legacy labels, regex, NLI or automated inference used. Scripts only serialize explicit decisions, compare arrays, and validate exact quotations/schema/coverage.33 initial disagreements across22 studies;9 final state changes across8 studies. Every disagreement and resolution preserved below. Remaining uncertainty is masked. Review certifies source-reading provenance, not diagnostic image accuracy.

initial_disagreements.resolution: Accept reader missing: normal otherwise bones does not characterize cortical/fracture status at the separately abnormal regions.
Accept reader uncertainty: relatively well-maintained cartilage with marginal osteophytes is qualified preservation, not a precise absence of threshold disease.
Accept reader uncertainty: named residual bruise overlaps subchondral impaction near bony avulsion, so independent nonfracture impact edema is not established.
Retain reviewer uncertainty: mild chondrosis without explicit superficial/low-grade depth or quantitative loss does not reliably establish the organizer cartilage threshold.
Accept reader uncertainty: explicit osteochondral impaction exclusion is relevant but narrower than all acute fracture.
Retain reviewer negative: straight ACL contour and only suspected mild mucoid degeneration describe a below-threshold degenerative signal finding without reported disruption; no tear is entertained.
Retain reviewer uncertainty: total erosion/ICRS4 establishes full depth, not unequivocal whole-facet or contiguous qualifying extent; the separate11mm loose body is not the cartilage-loss region.
Accept reader uncertainty: osteochondral loose body has unknown origin and acute timing, rather than no informative osseous mention.
Accept reader uncertainty: explicit subchondral medullary fibrovascular/fibrocystic changes inform marrow but do not establish impact causation.
Accept reader uncertainty: broader gonarthrosis with medial predominance leaves lateral involvement/localization insufficiently characterized.
